item.title: [Training Data] Suno's Mikey Shulman: Everyone Can Make Music Now
item.description: Speaker 1 | 00:00 - 00:25 Before Suno, basically everybody was a consumer of music. You know, compared to the 8,000,000,000 people on the planet, there are very few people who make music and the rest of us consume it. The crazy thing about Suno is that in any given day, 90% of the users are going to create something.
